title: Signed shift data for every integral pullback
statement:
theorem automorphismConstructibleStage_integral_shift_data
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] :
    ∀ (Z W : Scheme.{u}) (g : Z ⟶ W),
      ∃ (c : (integralOperationsPullbackComplexFunctor l E g).CommShift ℤ)
        (d : (integralDerivedPullback l E g).CommShift ℤ),
        IntegralCompletedComparison.ShiftCoordinates l E g c ∧
          IntegralCompletedComparison.ShiftDescent l E g c d

source.place: canonical shift clause of the Weil-structures paragraph

proof.text: For the canonical unrestricted reduction transition, compare its component on P[r] in degree i with its component on P in degree i+r. Both have the same value on every sheafified pure tensor by unrestrictedIntegralTransition_existsUnique. Tensor-generation extensionality proves equality. Apply the pullback-generator normalization and restricted pullback extensionality to obtain the identical component equality for each finite pullback transition. No invertibility assumption on ell on either scheme is used.

Give each finite pullback level its canonical additive termwise shift. The component equality from the first step is its transition CommShift equation. Form the product of the level shifts. On each product projection, the transition CommShift equation shows that one minus the adjacent tower shift commutes with this product shift.

Apply the existing signed mapping-cocone CommShift construction to this product endomorphism. Its two inclusion formulas are exactly ShiftCoordinates for the specified productShift: the first coordinate is unchanged and the second is multiplied by (-1)^r. The generic construction supplies both zero and addition coherence.

Use the proved good_stable, goodLocalization_essSurj and good_whisker_full helpers from CompletedScalarShiftDescent. The good full subcategory inherits shifts through its fully faithful inclusion. The generic descentShift helper transports the chain-and-Q CommShift through the retained integralDerivedPullbackComparison by fully faithful precomposition. Its component equation, after the identity inclusion comparison is simplified, is exactly ShiftDescent. Combine this descended structure with the constructed chain structure and its coordinate formulas.

proof_origin.place: Tags 011G, 014E, 06YS, 06YT and 0941. Direct generator normalization proves shift compatibility of the actual transitions; generic product, signed cocone and fully faithful descent APIs finish the proof without a finite strict-tower comparison.
